description: 50 hand-labelled newsletter stories and two user profiles for the offline recommendation evaluation. Labels were written by the author of the evaluation, per profile: relevant (would clearly want it), adjacent (related, useful context), irrelevant. A story with muteTags is primarily about a topic that some profiles mute; incidentalMentions only mention a topic in passing. Stories sharing a dupGroup are the same news from two newsletters.

project.text: Building a RAG chatbot using Python

B.name: AI agent learner (tool calling, orchestration, evaluation)

stories.headline: pgvector 0.8 adds iterative index scans for filtered similarity search
stories.blurb: The release keeps HNSW scans going until enough rows pass your WHERE clause, fixing the empty-result problem for filtered vector queries in PostgreSQL.

stories.headline: Hybrid search in PostgreSQL: full-text plus vector retrieval for RAG
stories.blurb: A walkthrough of combining tsvector ranking with embedding similarity using reciprocal rank fusion, with Python examples.

stories.headline: Chunking strategies compared for retrieval pipelines
stories.blurb: Fixed-size, sentence-aware and semantic chunking are benchmarked on question answering over technical docs; chunk overlap matters less than expected.

stories.headline: Choosing embedding dimensions and task types for Gemini embeddings
stories.blurb: Smaller output dimensions cut storage with little recall loss, and the retrieval query and document task types improve matching.

stories.headline: Streaming answers from a Python RAG chatbot with FastAPI
stories.blurb: Server-sent events let a retrieval-augmented chatbot show tokens as they arrive; the post covers cancellation and citations.

stories.headline: Second-pass scoring of search hits: small specialist models versus asking a chatbot to judge
stories.blurb: Re-scoring the top results with a purpose-built model is cheaper and often more accurate than prompting a general assistant to grade each passage.

stories.headline: Why chatbots that look things up still make things up
stories.blurb: Most wrong answers trace back to the lookup step returning the wrong passages, not to the writing step; showing sources helps users spot them.

stories.headline: HNSW or IVFFlat? Index showdown for pgvector on PostgreSQL
stories.blurb: Benchmarks on one million vectors show HNSW wins on recall and latency while IVFFlat builds faster.

stories.headline: pgvector benchmarks: HNSW against IVFFlat indexes in Postgres
stories.blurb: A new benchmark compares HNSW and IVFFlat on one million vectors: HNSW has better recall and latency, IVFFlat indexes build faster.

stories.headline: A practical guide to LLM evaluation: golden datasets and judging answers
stories.blurb: How to build a small labelled set, choose metrics and decide when an automated judge can be trusted.

stories.headline: LLM-as-judge pitfalls: position bias and verbosity bias
stories.blurb: Automated graders favour longer answers and the first option; calibration against human labels reduces the effect.

stories.headline: Evaluating agent trajectories: tool-use success and recovery from errors
stories.blurb: Beyond final answers, the article scores each step an agent takes and whether it recovers after a failed tool call.

stories.headline: Catching quality regressions when you edit a prompt
stories.blurb: Replay saved example questions after every wording change so a drop in answer quality fails the build before users notice.

stories.headline: Letting a model trigger your code: designing the interface it sees
stories.blurb: Precise parameter descriptions and structured error replies help a language model use external operations without guessing.

stories.headline: Why language models call the wrong API
stories.blurb: Vague names and overlapping descriptions make a model choose the wrong operation; trimming the menu offered at each step fixes most mistakes.

stories.headline: Coordinating several AI assistants that each own a subtask
stories.blurb: A lead assistant splits the work, hands pieces to specialists and merges what comes back; the article walks through the message flow.

stories.headline: Agent frameworks compared: LangGraph, CrewAI and plain Python loops
stories.blurb: Three ways to build an agent loop are compared on debuggability, state handling and lines of code.

stories.headline: How AI helpers plan ahead and remember: an architecture survey
stories.blurb: The survey groups designs by how a system plans its steps, stores what happened and reflects on the results.

stories.headline: MCP servers: a standard way for agents to reach tools and data
stories.blurb: The Model Context Protocol defines how an agent discovers and calls tools exposed by a server.

stories.headline: Keeping autonomous AI workers inside safe limits
stories.blurb: Scoped credentials, trial runs and approval steps limit the damage when an automated assistant acts on its own.

stories.headline: Why multi-agent systems fail: coordination and lost context
stories.blurb: Failure analysis of multi-agent LLM setups shows handoff errors and conflicting goals dominate.

stories.headline: Multi-agent LLM systems break down on coordination, new study finds
stories.blurb: A new study of multi-agent LLM setups reports that handoff errors and conflicting goals are the main causes of failure.

stories.headline: FastAPI gets faster dependency injection and lifespan improvements
stories.blurb: The release speeds up dependency resolution and simplifies startup and shutdown hooks for Python services.

stories.headline: Python free-threaded build: what backend developers should know
stories.blurb: Running without the GIL helps CPU-bound threads, but extension modules and libraries need to be checked first.

stories.headline: Async SQLAlchemy patterns for high-throughput Python services
stories.blurb: Session scoping, connection pooling and batching keep async database access fast and safe.

stories.headline: Kubernetes release adds gateway API and sidecar updates
stories.blurb: Cluster operators get stable gateway routing and better sidecar lifecycle handling for the orchestration of container workloads.

stories.headline: Terraform or Pulumi: infrastructure as code for small teams
stories.blurb: A comparison of languages, state handling and drift detection for teams without a platform group.

stories.headline: Rust new edition stabilises async closures
stories.blurb: The edition also tidies lifetime rules and adds new diagnostics for common borrow errors.

stories.headline: WebAssembly components reach a stable release
stories.blurb: The component model lets modules written in different languages call each other through typed interfaces.

stories.headline: CSS container queries now work in every major browser
stories.blurb: Components can respond to the size of their container instead of the viewport.

stories.headline: Gemini crypto exchange launches staking for institutional clients
stories.blurb: The exchange adds staking products and custody services for funds that hold digital assets.

stories.headline: RAG status reports: red, amber, green dashboards for project managers
stories.blurb: How to colour-code project health and keep stakeholders informed without drowning them in detail.

stories.headline: Real estate agents adopt virtual tours to speed up sales
stories.blurb: Agents report fewer wasted viewings after publishing three-dimensional walkthroughs of listings.

stories.headline: How to run a fair performance evaluation for your engineering team
stories.blurb: Set goals early, collect peer feedback and avoid recency bias in annual reviews.

stories.headline: Vector graphics: SVG animation techniques for web designers
stories.blurb: Path morphing, stroke drawing and masks bring icons to life without video files.

stories.headline: Python snakes: ball python population study tracks decline
stories.blurb: Field researchers tagged hundreds of ball pythons to measure how habitat loss affects the species.

stories.headline: Postgres or MySQL for small business accounting software
stories.blurb: A practical comparison of transactions, tooling and hosting costs for bookkeeping apps.

stories.headline: AI trading agents manage crypto portfolios as the startup raises $40M
stories.blurb: An agent-based trading startup announced a $40 million round to run automated cryptocurrency portfolios.

stories.headline: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit a record as prices climb
stories.blurb: Spot funds took in more than a billion dollars in a week while the token price reached a new high.

stories.headline: Ethereum upgrade lowers fees for layer-2 rollups
stories.blurb: The change makes posting rollup data cheaper, which should reduce transaction costs for users.

stories.headline: Series B: AI infrastructure startup raises $120M led by major investors
stories.blurb: The round values the company at over a billion dollars and will fund hiring and new data centres.

stories.headline: Vector database startup closes $60M funding round
stories.blurb: The company behind a hosted vector search service announced new funding to expand its cloud regions.

stories.headline: Latest flagship smartphone reviewed: camera and battery tests
stories.blurb: Our lab tests show strong low-light photos and a battery that lasts a full day and a half.

stories.headline: Budget phone roundup: the best handsets under $300
stories.blurb: Five affordable smartphones compared on screen, speed and software support.

stories.headline: pgvector adds binary quantization; sponsors include startup funding programs
stories.blurb: The extension can now store binary-quantized vectors for smaller indexes. Maintainers thanked their sponsors, including two startup funding programs.

stories.headline: Building agents that call tools: lessons from a team that used to build crypto wallets
stories.blurb: An engineering team explains how they moved from wallet software to agents with reliable tool calling.

stories.headline: Parallel tool calls: how LLM agents run several functions at once
stories.blurb: Agent loops can issue independent tool calls together; the post shows batching, ordering and error handling.

stories.headline: Running multiple tool calls in parallel inside agent loops
stories.blurb: Independent function calls can be issued together by an agent; this guide covers batching, ordering and handling errors.

stories.headline: Cheaper long prompts: reusing the shared prefix across requests
stories.blurb: Providers can reuse the processed beginning of a prompt, cutting latency and cost for applications that attach large document excerpts to every question.

stories.headline: Synthetic test data for evaluating retrieval systems
stories.blurb: Generate questions from your own documents to measure recall without hand labelling.
